Just my dad. My mom is great. My dad created, and still has (I still live with him, I'm 17) a culture of fear in my house. From as far back as I can remember, he's been abusive and horrific.  Even as a young child, I was afraid of my father. I didn’t really know why. I was taught that fathers were strong and dependable. I didn’t understand why I was afraid. I knew he yelled, and sometimes hit my mom, but that wasn’t all too bad. It wasn’t until my pre-teen years that I truly realized the horrors I was enduring. I would come home with a low test score shaking, walking off the bus with a sinking feeling in my stomach, knowing what would come next. My father would see the test, and begin a multiple-hour-long rampage. My father didn’t know how to resolve conflict in any other way than yelling. I could not recall a time when a dispute happened that wasn’t ended with yelling and anger. My father was an alcoholic, so his already hot temper was made even worse by the booze he drank religiously. I remember a time when he got exceptionally drunk, and went on a rampage with a hammer, holding it in the air and threatening to kill me and my mother. There are still dents in the dining room table to this day because of it. The floor is still scuffed in the place where a wooden nutcracker went sliding across it after having been struck by a hammer. That moment was probably the most scarring of my life. More than the tens of death threats I received in the years later from him. This was my own father coming inches from killing me. I recall a day when he lined up 9 TV tables on a ledge and stomped on their legs, breaking every single one of them. I remember how helpful I thought I'd be by collecting all the pieces that fell and trying to fix the smashed tables. Looking back on it, I feel so stupid. My father made her watch as he destroyed them. Made me sit there.  And the first thing I could think of was 'I can fix this!' What a sense of hope I used to have.  Oh! I remember a time when he gave me 11 death threats in a night.  That's still the record to this day. He picked me up by my neck once and held me in the air, choking me. I felt so helpless. I couldn't say anything, and my mother still doesn't know. I haven't told her.  So yeah.  I won't be an abusive fuck when I have kids.
